## Why

Describe the user-visible problem and why this change belongs in RustDroid's local APK receipt scope.

## What changed

- [ ] Code or documentation change is focused and documented.
- [ ] New behaviour has a reproducible command or fixture.
- [ ] Privacy-sensitive paths, APK data, and credentials are not included.

## Evidence

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] Relevant host/CI evidence or an explicit reason it could not run

## Checklist

- [ ] I updated the receipt/schema/support documentation when the contract changed.
- [ ] I added or updated a test.
- [ ] I reviewed the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and [Security policy](../SECURITY.md).
